Package org.unitseek.knitid.generator.uuid7

Class Uuid7Generator

java.lang.Object
org.unitseek.knitid.generator.uuid7.Uuid7Generator
All Implemented Interfaces:
IdGenerator
public final class Uuid7Generator extends Object implements IdGenerator
RFC 9562 UUIDv7 generator.

Layout: 48-bit Unix millisecond timestamp, version 7, variant 10, then 74 random bits. In monotonic mode the 74 random bits are treated as a counter (RFC 9562 section 6.2, method 2).

Instances are thread-safe. When monotonic mode is enabled and the random space of the current millisecond is exhausted, the configured MonotonicOverflow strategy decides whether to wait or fail.

Since:
1.0.0

    • generateUuid

      public UUID generateUuid()
      Generates a UUIDv7 without formatting it as a string.

      This is intended for generators such as TypeID that need the raw timestamp and random bits and would otherwise pay for a UUID string/parse round trip.

      Returns:
      generated UUIDv7
      Throws:
      IdGenerationException - if the clock is outside the 48-bit range or the monotonic random space is exhausted
